Fallback body is unreachable in modern Node where Object.hasOwn exists, so it's never invoked.
Forcing the split branch for dot-less paths still reduces over an empty keys array, returning object unchanged.
indexOf('') always 0 forces same branch as always-true case; split still uses real '.', so no observable change.
Paths like 'a.b' (dot at index 1) skip splitting, setting a literal 'a.b' key instead of nested a.b.
